comments: Chosen assumptions: agent1 starts 30–40 m ahead in the adjacent left lane of the same intended-direction lane group, but faces opposite that lane’s intended direction and accelerates straight. Ego follows its own lane in the intended direction. Agent1 initiates a close opposite-direction lateral pass; ego responds with lane following. The supplied property does not require lane crossing or collision, so the partners remain in adjacent lanes. Ego speed is 7–10 m/s, agent1 initial speed 6–9 m/s, and throttle 0.15–0.25.
